text:
Noah Kim: Following up on the postmortem - recurring pattern: brief host OOM or GC pause -> stream connection cut -> clients immediately reconnect -> reconnect storm -> many sessions end with 1 partial chunk. Need owners, short timelines, and an interim mitigation.

Priya Singh: I'll take LB/session-affinity audit. Hypothesis: affinity TTL shorter than client streaming TTL, causing re-routing during host recycle. I'll run a config diff and canary by EOD.

Ethan Morales: I'll own runtime throttling of reconnects and handshake jitter. Plan: open a draft PR with a feature flag to throttle recon attempts and add jitter to handshake retries. Target: PR by tomorrow morning.

Claire Dubois: I'll add observability: per-session reconnect histogram, partial-chunk ratio, and host OOM spike alerts. Want an alert rule prototype in 12h.

ops-bot: Incident snapshot: 2024-10-02T02:40Z - partial_response_peak=4.0%, reconnect_median=3, median_interval=410ms, affected_region=us-west-2.

Noah Kim: Interim mitigation suggestion: server-side debounce for immediate reconnects (ignore retries within 500ms) + increased LB affinity TTL as stopgap. Keep it conservative.

Priya Singh: Update 2210668005: found two edge pools with inconsistent affinity TTLs. Proposed quick change: unify TTL=300s and increase healthcheck grace to 25s. Will stage 5% canary.

Ethan Morales: Update 2210668200: PR opened behind flag reconnect_debounce_v1 -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4401 (draft). Config defaults in PR: debounce_ms=500, max_retries=6, jitter_ms=200. Adding unit tests now.

Claire Dubois: Update 2210668420: dashboard tiles up on staging, alert rule prototype created: partial_rate>2% AND reconnect_rate>1% for 1m -> page @oncall. Early canary telemetry: partials down 28%, reconnects down 36% in canary pool.

Noah Kim: Thanks team. Next sync in this thread tomorrow 10:00 UTC. If canary stays green, we'll plan gradual prod rollout and customer comms. Keep updates brief here. :thumbsup:
